neighbours.label: The word ' desperate' (also 'perate', ' desperation'); other emotion adjectives in the same frames stay quiet
fire: The farmers grew desperate after the drought.
She was desperate to find work.
A desperate crowd rushed the gate.
He made one last desperate attempt.
Many families are desperate for clean water.
They sounded desperate on the phone.
The king became a desperate man.
quiet: The farmers grew worried after the drought.
She was eager to find work.
A noisy crowd rushed the gate.
He made one last quick attempt.
Many families are thankful for clean water.
They sounded tired on the phone.
The king became a bitter man.
